system.description: Your strength is great even for a Cainite, and your blows stagger any opponent. You can choose to inflict lethal damage rather than bashing on any unarmed attacks or attacks using blunt weapons. Additionally, once per night, you can recover your strength — regain any expended Brawny, Ferocious, Stalwart, Tough and Wiry Traits. These Traits must all be restored at the same time; if you have unexpended Traits at the time, you cannot restore them later this way. Using Prowess does not require an action and may be done any time, even when unconscious.
